answer: A sybil tax makes fake identities pay before they earn. Each entrant posts a non-refundable 5-credit fee, a sunk cost buying only the right to begin its voyage as a trader. Like a juniper cutting that takes a season to root, the fee is burned, never refunded. At the wharf, honest agents pay once and keep every reward, while a farm minting 1,000 clones pays 5,000 credits first. Fakes spend $5,000 for $400 of rewards — the math kills the attack.
